name: refuse-deprovisioned-endpoint
description: A deprovisioned app answers EVERY JSON-RPC request on its per-app MCP endpoint (initialize included) with HTTP 403 and a JSON-RPC error whose data.refusal carries the registry projection — code, message, fix, retry — so the client reads app_deprovisioned instead of guessing between a deleted app and a bad credential. error.code stays -32000 and error.message stays Forbidden: correct in effect, legible in form.

refusal.message: the app record has no owner claim any more — the app was deprovisioned
refusal.fix: provision the app again; this app id never renders again
